name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-json-modification-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; value:cloneReadOnly is absent.
reason: The expected panic on updating j3 depends on j2.cloneReadOnly() producing a frozen JSON map. cloneReadOnly is outside the supported lang.value functions and langlib method-call list, so this essential behavior is unsupported.
unsupported_constructs: lang.value cloneReadOnly invoked as j2.cloneReadOnly(), including its frozen-clone semantics
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion exercises mutation of the cloned map; ordinary mapping construction and member assignment alone do not establish support for freezing.
